Select: chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id (from target_dictionary), target_name (from target_dictionary). Source: molecule_dictionary, drug_mechanism, target_dictionary, compound_structures. Join: molecule_dictionary to drug_mechanism on molregno; drug_mechanism to target_dictionary on tid; molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Filter: molecule_dictionary.max_phase = 4; drug_mechanism.action_type = 'BLOCKER'. Sort: chembl_id ASC, pref_name ASC, canonical_smiles ASC, max_phase ASC, mechanism_of_action ASC, action_type ASC, target_chembl_id ASC, target_name ASC.
